title: Simplify the macOS Git process cleanup to kill-group, deadline and a typed failure, removing the sysctl verifier and its unsafe helper
outcome: Simplify the macOS Git process cleanup to kill-group, deadline and a typed failure, removing the sysctl verifier and its unsafe helper
acceptance: After w-6bbabe3a062b lands, the macOS runner's cleanup on cancellation, deadline, drop and root exit kills Git's process group with killpg under the existing reserved process group and bounded deadline. It reports a typed failure naming the group and the error when cleanup can't be confirmed, and never reports success it can't observe. It no longer decodes kinfo_proc records through sysctl.
The separate macOS-only crate holding the unsafe sysctl call is removed, so Engram again contains no unsafe code; Linux behaviour and every Windows guarantee are unchanged

w-6bba's acceptance text is narrowed to match, citing Greg's direction, and the existing cleanup tests on the Mac and Linux still pass, with the fork-storm test asserting the typed outcome rather than an enumeration proof
